limitations: Actual constructed, fixed-weight one-hot bilinear selection of next PCs from lexical target table data for six reviewed WASM programs. Runtime control frame/stack effects and opcode dispatch remain host logic. Original WASM is validated and executed by independent Wasmtime and every executed state compared to v51. No neural label-stack compiler, general WASM typing, memory, calls, standard transformer layers, arbitrary decompilation or all-input equivalence theorem.
